text:
As a kid, I always wished Pokémon battles in the games could play out like they do in the anime.

So I built a real-time Pokémon battle experience with  @fal  H3 Max.

choose a move, the game calculates the outcome, and AI generates the animation on the fly. Paralysis, fainting, and  Pokémon is hurt are reflected on screen.
Project:https://t.co/wlsMg3tQEV
